additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0395420-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R3 170001481] Display & RFID defective CRM:00921001408
additional_info.body:
Hello Thore Grimm,
Thanks for the response.
As we checked the logs, it shows that the RFID tag was scanned, but OCPP is blocking it. The issue may be that these RFID cards are not whitelisted on the OCPP backend. Please check and whitelist the cards on the OCPP backend.
For the display issue, please provide a photo of the problem so that we can analyze it more effectively.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
